import unittest
from inventory import Cart

class DeclineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_zero_preserves_stock(self):
        cart = Cart(stock=4)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            cart.reserve(0)
        self.assertEqual(cart.stock, 4)
